summary: Both features fully match the approved design and acceptance criteria, and all three suites pass. FEAT-001: shared assertSessionEditable guard (utils/session-guard.ts) throws validationError (400 VALIDATION_ERROR, 'このセッションは既に完了しているため編集できません。') for COMPLETED and is wired into createCorrection (with getSessionById + session-not-found validationError), addSpeakerLabel, deleteSpeakerLabel, and post-consensus-resolve (getSessionById + guard before getSegment, no new docClient calls). ReviewPage COMPLETED path is read-only — editingEnabled/suggestionEnabled gated by !isReadOnly, onRevert disabled, speaker-manager panel hidden, role=status read-only note shown — while TranscriptionDownload render condition is unchanged. FEAT-002: reopenSession enforces requireRole TEAM_LEADER + ADMIN-all/TEAM_LEADER-own-team (isTeamMember), rejects non-COMPLETED with validationError (400), rejects missing with notFoundError (404), and routes directly through updateSessionStatus (policy A — ConsensusResult/Segment untouched; NOT changeSessionStatus). post-session-reopen handler records SESSION_REOPENED audit exactly once and returns { data: { sessionId, status } }; SESSION_REOPENED added to AuditOperationType; POST /sessions/{sessionId}/reopen route + PostSessionReopen Lambda registered in api-stack.ts with matching test assertion. Frontend reopenSession service (empty-body POST), ReopenSessionResult type, describeReopenError (403/404/400/other → JP), flat SessionReopenControls (Reviewer-hidden, COMPLETED-only, confirm step, role=status/alert), and App.tsx handleReopen wiring all match the design. Tests present: session-guard unit+property (numRuns 100), reopenSession service cases (403/own-team success asserting updateSessionStatus called exactly once/other-team 403/ADMIN/400 PENDING+IN_PROGRESS/404), handler audit-once + error surfacing, consensus-resolve COMPLETED→400, ReviewPage read-only + regression with vitest-axe, SessionReopenControls with vitest-axe, reopen-error, session-api. Results: backend npx vitest --run PASS (1159 passed, 85 skipped); frontend npx vitest --run PASS (1074) and npm run build PASS; infra npx vitest --run PASS (148, including the reopen route assertion). Note: the two pre-existing cdn-stack snapshot failures mentioned in FEAT-002 findings are not present in the current infra run — all 3 infra test files pass. Lint was not re-run here; FEAT-001/FEAT-002 findings record the remaining lint errors as pre-existing in files untouched by this task, which does not block approval.
